entity.name: Duplicate instar launchd daemon
entity.content: A duplicate plist at /Library/LaunchDaemons/ai.instar.Roland.plist was spawning duplicate instar-boot processes (PID 70063), while the correct user service is at ~/Library/LaunchAgents/ai.instar.Roland.plist. This caused multiple processes to compete for relay connection and prevented proper startup.

entity.name: Audit launchd across all directories for duplicates
entity.content: When instar or other services spawn duplicate processes, check ~/Library/LaunchAgents, ~/Library/LaunchDaemons, /Library/LaunchAgents, and /Library/LaunchDaemons for conflicting plist entries. System-wide daemons can shadow user agents.
